description: Frostbyte grounding and wrap-up. On session start, if the repo is linked via .frostbyte.json, tell the agent which Frostbyte project it is working in. Intentionally unmatcher-ed so it fires on every SessionStart event (startup, resume, clear, compact): grounding must survive resumes and context compaction. On stop, once per session, asks the agent to offer a Frostbyte sync when files changed but nothing was written to Frostbyte.
